profile_text.body:
IXL Learning operates IXL, which the company's site describes as a subscription-based learning site for K-12 covering math, language arts, science, social studies, and Spanish. The site says IXL is used by over 18 million students and offers personalized learning in more than 20,000 topics, with interactive questions, awards, and certificates. The company describes the product as combining a comprehensive K-12 curriculum, individualized guidance, and real-time analytics.

Two products are tracked for the company. IXL is listed with adaptive practice and diagnostic features, used by teachers, students, and families. Pricing for IXL is reported from a secondary source only: classroom licenses from $299/year for 25 students and family plans from $9.95/month. Vocabulary.com is listed with adaptive vocabulary practice for students and teachers, with district licenses by quote; one Florida district approved a 3-year contract for grades 7 to 12 not to exceed $226,127. Both entries note that student age and privacy details are not verified.

No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP servers are present in the available facts.
